A visual archive of hardware prototypes, flight-controller builds, Tau Labs / Sparky / BrushedSparky / TauOSD flight tests, CNC builds, LQG control experiments, and wearable EMG/EEG demos alongside the [Build & Crash archive](archive.qmd).

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
  const trigger = e.target.closest(".gallery-yt-trigger");
  if (!trigger) return;
  const ytId = trigger.getAttribute("data-yt-id");
  const title = trigger.getAttribute("data-yt-title") || "YouTube video";
  if (!ytId) return;
  const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
  iframe.src = "https://www.youtube.com/embed/" + encodeURIComponent(ytId) + "?autoplay=1&rel=0";
  iframe.title = title;
  iframe.className = "gallery-yt-iframe";
  iframe.allow = "accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture";
  iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
  trigger.replaceWith(iframe);
});
</script>
```
